name: St Mary's Cathedral and St Michael's Church at Hildesheim
description: In the German city of Hildesheim, two churches preserve the art of the early Middle Ages. St Michael's, built between 1010 and 1020, has a symmetrical plan with an apse at each end and a painted wooden ceiling. St Mary's Cathedral holds rich treasures, and Bishop Bernward's bronze door and column are among the finest metalwork of their age.
